declaration.negotiation_history_statement: As interim class counsel, I support preliminary approval. The parties reached agreement after three rounds of arm’s-length negotiations. Class relief and attorneys’ fees were discussed during the same negotiations; I do not represent that fees were first discussed only after class relief was agreed. The settlement provides a $27.5 million class fund, distributed automatically to identifiable class members without claim forms. Brightline will separately pay up to $4 million in fees and expenses, subject to court approval; it has not agreed to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any amount not awarded will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. In my judgment, the settlement provides substantial, prompt relief in light of the risks of class certification, trial, and delay. Approval remains for the Court to determine.
